nodes.label: Learnings log
Vite proxy needs ws:true for WebSockets
Refused WebSocket surfaces as close 1006
nodes.rationale: Anything a player must read a reason for (unknown code, rate limit) goes over plain HTTP first; the socket only carries live members and custom close codes.

nodes.label: Each distinguishable answer is an enumeration oracle
nodes.rationale: Unknown token and unknown room get the same ROOM_CLOSE_UNKNOWN and leave always answers 204, since the WebSocket route is not rate-limited.

nodes.label: DO hibernation: socket attachments
nodes.rationale: In-memory maps vanish on eviction, so a socket's member lives in serializeAttachment and members in storage.

nodes.label: Reduced-motion rule turned infinite animation into strobe
E2E loops must wait for each guess
nodes.rationale: A guess submitted while another is in flight is ignored by design; 'Enter was pressed' is not 'the guess was made'.

nodes.label: Read computed styles once settled
nodes.rationale: A test reading a computed style mid-transition can pass on the transition instead of the design.

nodes.label: Cloud sandbox blocks LRCLIB (emergency song)
Placeholder hid that no real score existed
nodes.rationale: A placeholder that makes a feature testable also makes it look finished; measure against the real model first.

nodes.label: frWac non_lem 200 skip-gram model (CC BY 3.0)
nodes.rationale: non_lem matters: a lemmatized model has no plurals or conjugated verbs.

nodes.label: Function words took the close-guess slots
Proximity scores as cosine ranks (100 - 20*log10(rank))
nodes.rationale: A fixed cosine threshold means something different per hidden word; ranking among the 50k most frequent words normalizes it. Placement at rank 1000 (NEAR_SCORE 40), up to 16 targets, cosine >= 0.2.

nodes.label: tokenize letter class missing oe ligature
Optimization pass: three isolate caches
nodes.rationale: Almost all cost was correct work repeated for a value that never changed.

nodes.label: Isolate caches need reset*() in tests
nodes.rationale: An isolate-level cache silently answers a question the next test meant to ask for real; add the reset in the same commit.

nodes.label: Component suite counting renders
nodes.rationale: Pin performance fixes with tests that count work, never timings.

nodes.label: cors maxAge to avoid preflights
LRC markup leaked as guessable words
nodes.rationale: Brackets are markup, parentheses are sung; a dropped line is removed outright, not blanked, so sections stay intact.
